incidente.resumo: A resource cleanup job executed by a partner service mistakenly targeted a resource group containing essential resources and removed them, degrading GitHub Copilot: the Copilot Chat error rate peaked at 63% and code scanning autofix dropped or delayed suggested fixes. Rerouting Copilot Chat traffic reduced its error rate below 6% while the removed resources were restored.

descricao.texto: A resource cleanup job executed by a partner service mistakenly targeted a resource group containing essential resources, leading to their removal.
trechos: We determined that the issue originated from a resource cleanup job executed by a partner service on July 13, which mistakenly targeted a resource group containing essential resources, leading to their removal.

passos.texto: The cleanup job was stopped in time to preserve some resources.
trechos: The job was stopped in time to preserve some resources, allowing GitHub to mitigate the impact while resources were being restored.

passos.texto: Copilot Chat traffic was rerouted between 01:00 and 02:00 UTC, reducing Copilot Chat error rates to below 6%.
trechos: We rerouted Copilot Chat traffic between 01:00 and 02:00 UTC, reducing Copilot Chat error rates to below 6%.

passos.texto: The impact was mitigated while the removed resources were being restored; the degradation lasted until 19:27 UTC.
trechos: The job was stopped in time to preserve some resources, allowing GitHub to mitigate the impact while resources were being restored.
On July 13, between 00:01 and 19:27 UTC, the GitHub Copilot service experienced degradation.

acoes.texto: Collaborate with partner services to implement safeguards against future incidents.
trechos: We are collaborating with partner services to implement safeguards against future incidents and enhancing our traffic rerouting processes to expedite future mitigation efforts.

observacoes: The document is a monthly availability report covering four incidents; only the July 13 Copilot incident was extracted. The year 2024 comes from the same report ('Beginning on July 18, 2024'), which covers incidents of that July. Code scanning autofix dropped suggested fixes until 12:38 UTC and delayed them until 21:38 UTC, beyond the stated 19h26m duration of the Copilot degradation. categoria_causa is other: the cleanup job that mistakenly targeted the resource group is described as executed by a partner service, not as an operator action, so human-error does not apply.
